exposure: conservative management with progesterone and/or bed resting
conservative management with progesterone and/or bed rest
cohort: Women diagnosed with cervical insufficiency between 16 and 24 weeks gestation
finding: Emergency cerclage was found to be effective and safe in preventing preterm birth and prolonging pregnancy in women with cervical insufficiency in the late second trimester compared to conservative management.
mod_finding: No difference in mode of delivery was found between groups.
